cards.text: Jesus is still up on the mountain, teaching His disciples. Now He talks about the Law and the Prophets, the Scriptures they already know. And He starts with what He did NOT come to do.

cards.question: Jesus says He has not come to abolish the Law or the Prophets. So what has He come to do with them?
Jesus says the tiniest marks in the Law, a jot or a stroke of a pen, will disappear before everything is accomplished.

cards.text: Not a jot, not a stroke, Jesus says, until heaven and earth pass away. Friend, that's smaller than the crumbs I miss EVERY time I wipe my counter.

cards.question: Jesus says whoever breaks one of the least commandments and teaches others to do the same will be called least in the kingdom of heaven. What about whoever practices and teaches them?

answers.text: Called a teacher of the Law
Called a friend of the prophets

cards.text: Then Jesus brings up the scribes and Pharisees, religious leaders in Israel. I bet every ear on that mountain perked right up.

cards.question: Jesus says that unless your righteousness ___ that of the scribes and Pharisees, you will never enter the kingdom of heaven.

cards.text: Now Jesus starts a pattern. First, what they've heard was said to the ancients: “Do not murder” and “Anyone who murders will be subject to judgment.”

cards.question: Then Jesus goes deeper than murder. He says anyone who is ___ with his brother will be subject to judgment.

cards.text: Words count too. Jesus says calling your brother “Raca” makes you subject to the Sanhedrin, Israel's high council, and saying “You fool!” makes you subject to the fire of hell.
Now picture someone at the altar, gift in hand, ready to offer it. And right there, they remember their brother has something against them.

cards.question: You're at the altar with your gift and you remember your brother has something against you. What does Jesus say to do?

answers.text: Leave the gift and go reconcile first
Offer the gift and pray for him after
Bring a bigger gift to make up for it

cards.text: Reconcile first, then come back and offer the gift. Friend, if I tried that with a batch in the oven, I'd come back and have to apologize to the cookies too.

cards.question: Jesus says that if an adversary is taking you to court, it's best to wait and let the judge settle it.

cards.text: Reconcile quickly, Jesus says, or your adversary may hand you to the judge, the judge to the officer, and into prison you may go. Friend, it's like ignoring a parking ticket: first a notice, then a late notice, then the TOW TRUCK.

cards.question: If it goes all the way to prison, what does Jesus say you'll have to pay before you get out?

cards.text: The pattern keeps rolling. Jesus says they've heard it was said, “Do not commit adultery.”

cards.question: With murder, Jesus went deeper to anger. Now He says anyone who looks at a woman to lust after her has already committed adultery with her in his ___.

cards.text: Then Jesus says if your right eye causes you to sin, gouge it out and throw it away. If your right hand causes you to sin, cut it off and throw it away.

cards.question: Jesus says to get rid of a right eye or a right hand that causes you to sin. Why does He say it?

answers.text: Losing one part beats your whole body in hell
The eye and the hand were the most unclean parts
The priests required it of anyone who sinned

cards.text: Next, Jesus says it has also been said, “Whoever divorces his wife must give her a certificate of divorce.”

cards.question: Jesus says anyone who divorces his wife brings adultery upon her, with one exception. What is it?

cards.text: And Jesus adds that he who marries a divorced woman commits adultery. This sermon doesn't skip the hard parts, friend.
Then Jesus says they've heard it was said to the ancients, “Do not break your oath, but fulfill your vows to the Lord.”

cards.question: They've heard they must not break their oaths. Now Jesus tells them not to swear at all.

cards.text: Not by heaven, Jesus says, because it's God's throne. Not by the earth either, because it's His footstool.

cards.question: Jesus says not to swear by Jerusalem either, for it is the city of the great ___.
After heaven, earth and Jerusalem, Jesus says it's still fine to swear by your own head.

cards.text: Not even your head, Jesus says, because you can't make a single hair white or black. Friend, if I had ANY say over hair, this mustache would match my gold base.

cards.question: Instead of swearing by heaven, earth, Jerusalem or your head, what does Jesus say to do?

answers.text: Let your yes be yes and your no be no
Make every promise in front of witnesses
Swear only by the name of the Lord

cards.question: Jesus says anything more than a plain yes or no comes from the evil one.

cards.text: Next, Jesus says they've heard it was said, “Eye for eye and tooth for tooth.” Sounds fair, but hold on, friend.

cards.question: They've heard “Eye for eye and tooth for tooth.” What does Jesus say about an evil person?
If someone slaps you on your right cheek, what does Jesus say to do?

answers.text: Turn to him the other cheek also

cards.text: Jesus keeps going. If someone wants to sue you and take your tunic, let him have your cloak as well.

cards.question: And if someone forces you to go one mile, Jesus says to go with him ___ miles.
Jesus says to give to the one who asks, but to turn away the one who wants to borrow from you.

cards.text: And the last one in the pattern. They've heard it was said, “Love your neighbor” and “Hate your enemy.”

cards.question: They've heard “Love your neighbor” and “Hate your enemy.” What does Jesus tell them to do?

answers.text: Love your enemies and pray for those who persecute you
Love your neighbor and keep away from your enemies
Forgive your enemies once they make things right

cards.question: Jesus says to love your enemies and pray for those who persecute you, so that you may be ___ of your Father in heaven.
Jesus points to how the Father treats people. He says the Father sends rain only on the righteous.

cards.text: Same sun and same rain for the evil and the good, the righteous and the unrighteous. Friend, the sun even comes up on ME, and I've burned more batches than I'm willing to admit.

cards.question: Jesus asks: if you love those who love you, what reward will you get? Do not even ___ do the same?
Jesus says greeting only your brothers is something even the Gentiles, people who aren't Jewish, do.
Jesus wraps it all up. What does He tell them to be, as their heavenly Father is?

cards.text: Hang on to your apron, friend. Jesus isn't done teaching on that mountain yet.
